title: The Broken Shift
description: Joke mod that removes shift key input in game.
body:
# THE BROKEN SHIFT
**The shift they buy. The shift they broke.**
### Features
The concept is simple - this mod brokes shift key input in Minecraft. It's a joke mod which parodies website of the known horror mod called The Broken Script.

**THINGS YOU WANT TO KNOW BEFORE PLAYING**
- Mod can broke your shift.
- Mod will not ban and kick you from your world.
- Mod will not destroy your ugly buildings.
- Mod isn't scery.

**See the more scery mod: [The Broken Script](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-broken-script)**
